Uplink ServiceOps Console

One console for tickets, assets, projects and network operations, with a single search across all of them.

Private. Walkthrough on request at support@lemonshops.app.How to useIn motion

01

Problem

Small IT teams juggle a ticket system, an asset spreadsheet and separate network tools, each with its own login, and the records drift apart.

02

What it does

Status-coded ticket workflows, an asset register linked to sites and owners, projects with tasks, and network operations organized by site and address. One search box finds any record. New accounts get a practice lab. Light and dark themes.

03

How it is built

React and TypeScript on a single Postgres database for every module, with a custom design system. Paused while Uplink grows; it will be the console Uplink learners move on to.

04

In motion

Four frames that summarize the platform. Click to advance.
